title: Quarterly OKR Consolidation Exchange & Initiative Inbox Workflow
text:
Quarterly OKR Consolidation Exchange & Initiative Inbox Workflow

description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable process (and supporting intake UI) for consolidating quarterly company-level OKR proposals into a single 'Exchange' where Product, Eng, Design, Sales, and GTM can negotiate scope, capacity and critical dependencies. The Exchange pairs a visible initiative inbox with a prioritization window and a set of guardrails so leaders can agree on initiative acceptance, expected outcomes, and a fallback plan.

Background: We've historically done OKR intake via emails + docs which creates duplicate work, missed dependencies at handoff, and a lack of measurable acceptance for company initiatives. This ticket is the PM-led effort to define the workflow, acceptance criteria, and minimal UI/operational artifacts required to run the Exchange in Q2 planning.

Scope:
- Define owner roles (Submitter, Initiative Steward, Capacity Reviewer, Approver) and handoff flow.
- Create the initiative inbox schema (fields: objective mapping, estimated FTE/points, key dependencies, risk rating, success metrics, required infra).
- Draft a short intake form and the prioritization rubric for the Exchange.
- Prototype a lightweight intake view in the Console -> "Initiative Exchange" (mock, not full shipping product).
- Run 2 pilot team receptions during the next planning cycle and capture feedback.

Out of scope: Full automation with dedicated backend workflows, integrations with HR capacity or payroll, or built-in budget allocation (those will be future work).

acceptance_criteria:
1) Stakeholder RACI agreed and published in Confluence. 2) Intake schema documented and validated by Eng, Design, and Sales. 3) Prioritization rubric tested on 6 sample initiatives with clear scoring results. 4) Prototype mock linked in the doc and demo'd to leadership. 5) Pilot-run retro with actionable improvements recorded.

comments:
2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Ethan), Design (Lina), and GTM (Marco). Agreed to prioritize speed: start with a simple form and rubric, iterate after pilot.
2025-02-18: Design uploaded initial mock to Drive and Figma (link below). Lina: suggest adding a 'regulatory sensitivity' flag for Private customers — flagged as optional field for now.
2025-02-22: Engineering (Ethan) scoped prototype as 5 pts; proposed building a temporary Console tab rendering a JSON-backed view. Dependency: small API endpoint to fetch initiative metadata (ENG-4512).
2025-02-26: PM review with exec sponsors (Aisha, Raj). Feedback: make acceptance criteria outcome-led (not feature-led) and include a clear rollback policy for initiatives that underperform. Added to the acceptance criteria.
2025-03-03: Pilot plan drafted — two teams (Runtime & Console) will submit intake forms by 2025-03-15. PM to run a 30-minute Exchange meeting the week of 2025-03-17. Action: Sophia (PM ops) to schedule calendar invites.
2025-03-05: Design/Eng alignment session. Decided to keep fields minimal for pilot: objective, owner, estimated points, primary dependency keys, success metric (1-2 KPIs), risk level. Next: product spec PR and Confluence playbook update.
